section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Aarau; other communes differ) and church tax
label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Aarau; other communes in Aargau set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
